canonical_equations: Normalize supplied direction with separate RN32 operations; exact rational Moller-Trumbore determinants/barycentrics; abs(det)>=RN32(1e-8); RN32(t)>RN32(1e-4); min RN32 positive t, miss RN32(1e30); two-sided closed triangle edges
input_contract: encoding=binary32-hex; triangles[M,3,3], rays[N]={origin[3],direction[3]}; each input component zero or magnitude 2^-16..2^16; nonzero directions; 1<=M,N<=4096 and M*N<=1048576; no hidden quantization
output_contract: N binary32 nearest-hit distances, original ray order; miss=0x7149f2ca
result_contract: N binary32 nearest-hit distances, original ray order; miss=0x7149f2ca
precision_requirements: Exact rational intersection on preserved binary32 inputs; canonical RN32 direction normalization and final distance. Dynamic RN32 frozen sine offset and addition. GPU signed 256-bit integer determinants; no float narrowphase, no quantization.
validation_method: Full CPU/GPU raw-byte equality for every ray and, for dynamic jobs, every mutated vertex at every requested frame, warmup and final; generic, RT update and rebuild independently checked

licensing_provenance.implementation: Original ASTRO implementation of published equations; no external code copied.
licensing_provenance.reference_license: Paper reference only; original exact-rational / integer implementation, no source copied

RT_backend: Conservative AABB ray-query broadphase + exact 256-bit determinant narrowphase; dynamic has BLAS and TLAS update and rebuild paths
RT_applicability: BVH prunes ray/triangle candidates; hardware-computed triangle distance is never accepted as the answer
scientific_scope: Geometric primitive / local commissioning. No public science credit; original tolerant GPU-vs-GPU tests are not independent proofs.
legacy_compatibility: Scientific operator and input representation retained; deterministic rounding/serialization strengthened. Not a claim of identical bytes to historical tolerant executors.
